description: A generated plan whose top-level keys mix types (a tool's params mapping has a plain on: key, which YAML 1.1 resolves to the bool True, beside string keys) still runs, and its orchestration_sha256 is the sha256 of its canonical JSON text -- the canonical key order falls back to each key's own JSON text where native comparison can't order a bool key against a string one, rather than raising the way a plain sort_keys=True json.dumps call would.
